metadata.query: How do I disable pop-up ads on my browser?

final_answer: To disable pop-up ads on Google Chrome, go to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > Pop-ups and redirects, then toggle the switch to block pop-ups. For Firefox, go to Options > Privacy & Security > Content Blocking > Custom, add 'pop-ups' to the Exceptions list if it's not already there, and set it to Allow Blocking. [Sources: search_knowledge_base results]
